# Public Pages Requirements Quality Checklist: Tracking Page, Merchant Link, and WhatsApp Message

**Purpose**: Formal gate on the quality of the requirements for what public pages show and hide, link security, wording per status and kind, the merchant message, and the merchant page, before they are turned into tasks
**Created**: 2026-09-30
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · supporting: [data-model.md](../data-model.md), [research.md](../research.md), [contracts/http-api.md](../contracts/http-api.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

**Focus**: privacy and link security · wording for every status and shipment kind · the merchant message · the merchant page · consistency with features 001–003
**Depth**: formal gate · **Reviewer and timing**: project owner, before `/speckit-tasks`

## Privacy and Link Security

- [x] CHK001 Is the set of fields shown on the tracking page stated exhaustively, including how the destination is identified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, §FR-004]
- [x] CHK002 Is the destination shown defined for every kind, including carrier handoffs and reverse pickups? [Coverage, Spec §FR-003, §FR-008]
- [x] CHK003 Is "first name" of the courier defined precisely? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK004 Is showing the received-by name on a forwardable link an explicit, owner-approved decision? [Assumption, Spec §US1, Business master decision #8]
- [x] CHK005 Is the limit on trying links quantified? [Measurability, Spec §FR-011, §SC-005]
- [x] CHK006 Is it stated what an expired, replaced, or deactivated link reveals, consistently with an invalid one? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, §FR-011]
- [x] CHK007 Is the lifetime of a merchant link stated? [Gap, Spec §FR-021]
- [x] CHK008 Is it stated that photos are reachable only through the merchant page? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, §FR-022]
- [x] CHK009 Is the 30-day window of the merchant page applied to shipment details as well as to the list? [Consistency, Spec §FR-019, §FR-020]
- [x] CHK010 Are search indexing and link previews addressed? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK011 Is it stated that public pages accept no input? [Completeness, Spec §FR-024]

## Wording for Every Status and Kind

- [x] CHK012 Does the status table cover every shipment status of the shared lifecycle, including held and rescheduled shipments? [Coverage, Spec §FR-005, Feature 003 §FR-029–FR-031]
- [x] CHK013 Is the wording after an exception with a new attempt defined, so the page does not read as a new shipment? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK014 Are the reverse pickup texts defined for each stage? [Coverage, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK015 Are errand texts defined, rather than reusing package wording? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK016 Is the time format and time zone of "a las {time}" specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK017 Are the exception reasons translated to plain words for recipients? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK018 Is "entregas antes de la tuya" defined for reverse pickups and for stops completed out of order? [Coverage, Spec §FR-006, §EC-06]
- [x] CHK019 Are the conditions to show the courier consistent with custody and handovers of features 002 and 003? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, §EC-03]
- [x] CHK020 Is the amount to pay hidden in every final status? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014]

## The Merchant Message

- [x] CHK021 Is it defined which shipments a message includes (date, not voided, not yet notified, or all)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016]
- [x] CHK022 Is the moment a shipment counts as notified stated, including when the dispatcher does not actually send? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017]
- [x] CHK023 Is the behavior defined for merchants without a WhatsApp number and for long lists? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-016, §FR-017]
- [x] CHK024 Is it stated how a merchant learns its link after a replacement? [Gap, Spec §FR-021]
- [x] CHK025 Is it stated that no message is sent automatically? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017, §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK026 Can SC-001 be measured (time and taps per merchant)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]

## The Merchant Page

- [x] CHK027 Are the fields of the list and of a shipment's detail stated exhaustively? [Completeness, Spec §FR-019, §FR-020]
- [x] CHK028 Are the day totals defined, including what they exclude? [Clarity, Spec §FR-019]
- [x] CHK029 Is the refresh of an open merchant page specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK030 Is the display of a fee under review defined consistently with feature 001? [Consistency, Spec §FR-019, Feature 001 §FR-035]
- [x] CHK031 Is merchant isolation stated as a requirement? [Completeness, Spec §US3, §FR-020]

## Non-Functional and Acceptance

- [x] CHK032 Is "slow mobile connection" quantified? [Measurability, Spec §FR-013, §SC-003]
- [x] CHK033 Can SC-006 and SC-007 be measured during the pilot? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006, §SC-007]
- [x] CHK034 Can SC-004 be verified for every status and kind? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [x] CHK035 Does every edge case map to a functional requirement? [Traceability, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK036 Are the dependencies on features 001–003 stated, and is it stated that this feature changes none of their rules? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline

## Review record

- **2026-09-30**: all 36 items evaluated by the assistant at the reviewer's explicit request
  and marked satisfied after revising the spec. Seventeen were satisfied as written (CHK004,
  CHK008, CHK010, CHK011, CHK017, CHK019, CHK020, CHK022, CHK023, CHK025, CHK026, CHK027,
  CHK030, CHK031, CHK034, CHK035, CHK036); the other 19 required a change.
- The spec keeps 24 functional requirements; FR-003, FR-005–FR-008, FR-011, FR-013, FR-016,
  FR-019–FR-021, SC-003, SC-006, and SC-007 were tightened.
- Rules decided by the assistant, open to the reviewer's change:
  - the destination shown is the recipient's neighborhood, or the carrier and town for a
    carrier handoff (CHK001, CHK002);
  - the courier's first name is the first word of the name (CHK003);
  - at most 60 requests a minute from one origin (CHK005);
  - after an exception, a new attempt reads "Reprogramado para {date}" (CHK013);
  - texts for reverse pickups and errands (CHK014, CHK015);
  - voided shipments are left out of messages and totals (CHK021, CHK028);
  - a merchant link never expires unless replaced or the merchant is deactivated (CHK007);
  - "weak mobile connection" means about 1.5 Mbps with high latency (CHK032).
- While reviewing, requirement numbers left stale by an earlier renumbering were corrected in
  the research, data model, contract, and plan.
